quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #19
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 21

questions.question: Which factor affects how fast a person absorbs alcohol?
questions.correctAnswerText: Weight
questions.explanation: A person's weight affects how fast they absorb alcohol. Other factors include biological sex, how much food is in their stomach, and how many drinks they have had. The only way to remove alcohol from your system is to wait.

questions.question: When approaching a roundabout, you should always:
questions.correctAnswerText: Decrease your speed.
questions.explanation: Slow down when approaching a roundabout. Roundabouts are designed to be driven at low speeds.

questions.question: Which road surface freezes first?
questions.correctAnswerText: A bridge
questions.explanation: Bridges freeze before other road surfaces. Bridges often become icy even when nearby roads are dry. They freeze first and thaw last.

questions.question: A driver should watch carefully for motorcyclists, bicyclists, and pedestrians because:

options.text: They're difficult to see in traffic.
They obey different traffic laws than larger vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: They're difficult to see in traffic.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles, bicycles, and pedestrians are hard to spot because they are smaller than cars. Even when drivers are looking, they may not see them. Be alert to these smaller road users to prevent crashes.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: When should your wheels NOT point straight ahead?

options.text: When waiting to make a left turn at a traffic light.
When parked on a hill or sloping driveway.
When parked on a level roadway with no curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: When parked on a hill or sloping driveway.
questions.explanation: Keep wheels straight when waiting to turn left at a light. If hit from behind, this prevents you from sliding into oncoming traffic. On hills, turn your wheels so your car won't roll into traffic if the brakes fail.

questions.question: A U-turn is not permitted:

options.text: On or near any curve or hill.
On a straight road with clear visibility for 500 feet.

questions.correctAnswerText: On or near any curve or hill.
questions.explanation: Never make a U-turn on or near a curve or hill. You cannot see oncoming traffic or pedestrians and may cause a crash.

questions.question: A large truck ahead is turning right onto a street with two lanes in each direction. The truck:

options.text: May complete its turn in either of the two lanes.
May have to swing wide to complete the right turn.
Must stay in the right lane at all times while turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: May have to swing wide to complete the right turn.
questions.explanation: When a vehicle turns, its rear wheels follow a shorter path than its front wheels. Long trucks need extra space and may swing wide to complete a right turn safely.

questions.question: If a driver is worried, nervous, angry, or crying, they:

options.text: Can drive faster because they sense more.
Should calm down and focus before starting the car.
Should call a friend to talk while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should calm down and focus before starting the car.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions distract you from driving. Worry, anger, crying, or excitement pulls your mind away from the road. Calm yourself and focus before you start driving.

questions.question: When driving near a large commercial vehicle, you should:

options.text: Follow closely to reduce wind drag on your car.
Avoid driving beside it for long periods.
Drive on its right side on curves and hills.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid driving beside it for long periods.
questions.explanation: Large trucks have large blind spots on each side. Do not drive beside them for long periods of time.

questions.question: Construction zone signs are generally what shape and color?

options.text: Square or rectangular with white and red colors.
Round or octagonal with black and yellow colors.
Diamond-shaped or rectangular with orange and black colors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Diamond-shaped or rectangular with orange and black colors.
questions.explanation: Work zone signs are orange with black letters or symbols. You will see them on the right side of the road, or on both sides if the highway is divided.

questions.question: When another vehicle is passing you, what should you do?

options.text: Keep driving at the same speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving at the same speed.
questions.explanation: When being passed, do not speed up. Let the other vehicle pass safely and merge back into your lane.

questions.question: What type of drug is alcohol?
questions.correctAnswerText: A depressant.
questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant. It slows your nerve impulses and body functions. It reduces your ability to focus and stay alert.

questions.question: If your car skids on water, should you quickly apply the brakes?
questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: If your car hydroplanes, try to regain control. If you cannot, release the accelerator and let the skid pass. Do not brake suddenly.

questions.question: At a light rail intersection, what should you always do?

options.text: Look both ways before crossing tracks.
Pay attention and obey all traffic signals.
Share the road with pedestrians and bicyclists.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of these.
questions.explanation: Never drive around lowered crossing gates. Always look both ways before crossing tracks and obey all signs and signals. Trains share the road with cars and bicyclists.

questions.question: If your car breaks down on the highway, what should you do?

options.text: Park with all four wheels off the road, if possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Park with all four wheels off the road, if possible.
questions.explanation: When your car breaks down, park all four wheels off the main road if you can.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean?

options.text: Stop and look for other vehicles, then go if the road is clear.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to clear the intersection quickly.
Slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and go carefully.

questions.question: Should drivers avoid driving beside large vehicles for long periods of time?
questions.correctAnswerText: TRUE
questions.explanation: Large vehicles have large blind spots on both sides. Do not stay beside a large vehicle for long. Move ahead or fall back to stay safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Go no faster than 35 mph around the curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go no faster than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. Speed advisory signs show the safe speed for the curve.

questions.question: On the freeway, you see a "Merging traffic" sign. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On multi-lane roads, make room for traffic entering. If no one is next to you, move to another lane.

questions.question: If you stop along the road at night, what should you do?

options.text: Turn on your emergency flashers and keep your low beams on.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your emergency flashers and keep your low beams on.
questions.explanation: When you stop on the road at night, turn on your emergency flashers and keep your low beams on. This helps other drivers see your vehicle clearly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Crossroad ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: A vehicle coming toward you has its high beams on and you cannot see the road. What should you do?

options.text: Look ahead toward the left edge of your lane.
Look ahead toward the right edge of your lane.
Look straight ahead in your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look ahead toward the right edge of your lane.
questions.explanation: Do not look directly at the oncoming headlights. Instead, look toward the right edge of your lane and watch the other vehicle from the corner of your eye.

questions.question: How can you avoid hitting vehicles in your blind spots?

options.text: Turn your head quickly to check your blind spot before changing lanes.
Adjust your rearview mirrors every few minutes.
Honk your horn right before turning or changing lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head quickly to check your blind spot before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Before you turn or change lanes, turn your head and look over your shoulder to check your blind spot. Do not rely on mirrors alone.

questions.question: What do your brake lights tell other drivers?

options.text: You are slowing down or stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are slowing down or stopping.
questions.explanation: Brake lights tell other drivers that you are slowing down or stopping. Your brake lights must work properly at all times while driving.

questions.question: A red traffic light is on, but a police officer tells you to go through the intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Stop until the light turns green.
Go through the intersection without stopping.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go through the intersection without stopping.
questions.explanation: Police officers directing traffic have authority over traffic lights and signs. Follow the officer's directions.

questions.question: How can you help reduce road rage and aggressive driving?
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: To prevent road rage, use proper turn signals, obey speed limits, and allow plenty of time for your trip.

questions.question: This sign shows a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Keep the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing marked with this sign, slow down, look both ways, and listen for trains. Be ready to stop if a train is near. Never try to beat a train.

questions.question: What does a red traffic light mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: A red traffic light means you must stop. You must stop at the stop line, before any crosswalk, and before the intersection.

questions.question: Can you cross a double solid yellow centerline to pass another vehicle?

options.text: Yes, if there is no oncoming traffic.
Yes, if the vehicle ahead is driving under the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: No.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing. You cannot cross these lines to pass. You can only cross double yellow lines when turning into a driveway or business entrance.
